facebookresearch_ridgesfm/ridgesfm/eval_.eval_depth: evaluate predicted depth against ground truth depth tensors and return MSE, RMSE, and absolute error metrics
facebookresearch_ridgesfm/ridgesfm/eval_.eval_pose: evaluate predicted camera poses against ground truth poses computing center and angle errors with optional alignment

facebookresearch_ridgesfm/ridgesfm/eval_.eval_scannet: run full ScanNet evaluation over a directory of split files using a SLAM function handle and print averaged results

facebookresearch_ridgesfm/ridgesfm/mobil.build_InvertedResidual_block: build an InvertedResidual block with configurable kernel size, stride, and h_swish activation

facebookresearch_ridgesfm/ridgesfm/mobil.build_conv_1x1_bn_layer: build a 1x1 pointwise convolution layer with batch normalization and h_swish activation

facebookresearch_ridgesfm/ridgesfm/ridge.run_ridgesfm_pipeline: run the ridgesfm pipeline to reconstruct a 3D scene from images using ridge-based SfM and bundle adjustment
facebookresearch_ridgesfm/ridgesfm/ridge.build_unet_network: build a UNet neural network for ridge feature extraction with configurable depth and feature channels
facebookresearch_ridgesfm/ridgesfm/ridge.run_pairwise_ridge_sfm: run pairwise ridge-based SfM with RANSAC across image pairs to estimate camera poses

facebookresearch_ridgesfm/ridgesfm/utils.run_match_kcrosscheck: run k-nearest neighbor cross-check matching between two descriptor tensors using FAISS to find mutual matches
facebookresearch_ridgesfm/ridgesfm/utils.run_matches_ratiotest: run ratio test matching between two descriptor tensors using FAISS to filter matches by distance ratio
facebookresearch_ridgesfm/ridgesfm/utils.run_load_scene: run load_scene to load a scene from disk, predict depth planes with a UNet, and extract SIFT/ORB/SuperPoint features
facebookresearch_ridgesfm/ridgesfm/utils.run_prematch_scene: run prematch_scene to compute pairwise feature matches across all image edges in a scene using FAISS and fundamental matrix filtering
